description.value: Green Waves Salads is a salad-focused fast food establishment located in Tofino, BC. As a quick-service spot in a popular surf and cycling destination, it would cater to health-conscious visitors seeking fresh food options. Current operational status is uncertain.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record explicitly carries opening_hours=closed, which is the strongest available signal and suggests this business may be permanently closed rather than simply having no hours listed. The only URL is a discovered Instagram link (medium confidence) that returned only generic Instagram login-wall pages with no business-specific content whatsoever, making it impossible to corroborate any details about the business. No address, phone, or operational evidence could be confirmed from any source.
concerns: OSM tag opening_hours=closed indicates possible permanent closure — manual verification required.
